name: quantified-self
description: Analyze authorized Quantified Self data with focused activity, measurement, training, sleep, and route workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze your fitness, health, sleep, and routes.
interface.longDescription: Connect your authorized Quantified Self data for focused read-only workflows covering cross-domain trends, training, sleep, body measurements, activity performance, charts, and saved routes.
defaultPrompt: Give me my daily report with sleep HRV and sleep heart rate for Europe/Helsinki.
Show my body-weight trend and explain the change without making medical claims.
Plot pace and heart rate for my latest run and summarize the key sections.
